notes: two isnads to al-Hasan b. Rashid, each written in full, so two groups and a null tail
«جميعا عن القاسم بن يحيى» in the first isnad: the three shaykhs meet at القاسم بن يحيى
«جدّه الحسن بن راشد» is one link with the name alone (rule 7); the first «عن الحسن بن راشد» in the opening names the book's source, not a route
«أبي» and «أبيه» are bare relations; the blessings and «رضي اللّه عنه» are left out
